title: CLM-014: staged critics versus a single writer on seeded defects
description: Compares the default staged graph (independent critics and repair loop) against a single-writer baseline that plans, builds and verifies its own work. Restricted to the two tasks that carry seeded defects.

hypothesis.statement: Separating planning, production, and verification reduces correlated error and self-certification risk compared with a single blended loop.
hypothesis.falsifier: The default workflow does not let fewer seeded defects reach implemented-awaiting-human-release-review than a single-node workflow that plans, builds, and verifies its own work.

arms.label: Staged default graph
arms.description: No workflow override: the default graph-native workflow runs.
